capabilities: Trigger a configured Alfred workflow from the active document
Pass the note's name, path, and frontmatter properties as a base64-encoded JSON argument
Resolve a wikilink under the cursor or selection and send the linked note instead
Configure the Alfred bundle ID and external trigger ID in settings
extras: macOS only; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the author mentions their own Alfred Markdown Curator Workflow as a companion.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand the currently active document, including its properties, to the Alfred launcher on macOS.

relations.evidence: This command sends the document name, path, and frontmatter properties to your local Alfred workflow.
The Alfred Markdown Curator Workflow I built works great with this plugin!

summary: macOS-only plugin that triggers an Alfred workflow with the active note's name, path, and frontmatter properties via an alfred:// URL.
